A UI frame of the panel of the kawaii UI style for an anime adventure gacha of bright skies, ivory halls and star pulls: a panel's border and ground, its centre plain so text reads on it.
Style: Anime cel-shaded 3D. 3D models drawn with the hard shadow shapes and contour lines of 2D animation, framed and timed like an anime cut. Cel shadows as designed shapes, lines that thin with distance, tinted shadows, dynamic camera and impact frames.
Palette: at most 48 distinct colours in this asset; at most 2 shades per hue from shadow to highlight; 24 to 48 colours; two tones per material (lit, shadow) with hue-shifted shadows; highlights as shapes.
Nine-slice: the corners (25% left, 25% top, 25% right, 25% bottom of each cell) keep their size, the edges between them stretch along one axis and the centre both ways: put every ornament in the corners, keep the edges even along their length and the centre plain.
Conform: the cook then the look's 2.5-pixel outline drawn round the shape (docs/art.md §2.3): draw for that.
Background: fully transparent, nothing outside the subject.
Line: a near-black #141028 line about 2.5 pixels wide at the size it is seen.
Reference: the image shows the style; match its palette, line and rendering, not its content.
Avoid: physically based specular; soft shadows on characters; outlines of uniform screen width at every distance; a background or ground shadow; text, letters or watermarks.
Shape: one single panel only, centred, filling the image across its width, 1.00 times as wide as it is tall (96 x 96 proportions); nothing else in the image.
Art direction: A warm ivory panel, completely opaque and solid everywhere including its centre (no hole, no transparency, no vignette): a flat ivory #fcf9f4 ground, very softly rounded corners (about 16 px at this size), a fine 1.5 px pale-gold hairline just inside its edge, a tiny four-point gold sparkle in the top-left and bottom-right corners only. As the cream panels of the concept's settings and shop. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): every ornament sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.
The reference images are the approved concept of this style's screens: paint this piece as it appears there, in their exact material, colour, ornament and finish; do not copy their layout or text.
